displaySummary.zh: AI100（2022-2023）· 对话式指令遵循 AI

displayDescription.en:
ChatGPT launched publicly on November 30, 2022 as a research preview built from the InstructGPT lineage. It used supervised dialogue data and reinforcement learning from human feedback so the model could answer follow-up questions, acknowledge mistakes and respond within a continuing conversation.

The accessible chat interface dramatically lowered the barrier to trying a general-purpose language model. Its rapid adoption changed public expectations for search, writing, coding, education and human-computer interaction, while exposing reliability and safety limits at unprecedented scale.
displayDescription.zh:
ChatGPT 于 2022 年 11 月 30 日作为研究预览公开发布，技术路线承接 InstructGPT。它使用监督式对话数据和基于人类反馈的强化学习，使模型能够回答追问、承认错误，并在连续对话中作出回应。

易用的聊天界面大幅降低了体验通用语言模型的门槛。它的快速普及改变了公众对搜索、写作、编程、教育和人机交互的预期，也以前所未有的规模暴露出可靠性与安全局限。

html.en: Instruction-tuned models had already improved compliance with user requests, but they were mostly encountered through APIs and demonstrations. ChatGPT paired that post-training lineage with a persistent dialogue interface and released it as a public research preview.
html.zh: 指令调优模型已经改善了对用户请求的遵循，但公众此前主要通过 API 和演示接触它们。ChatGPT 把这条后训练路线与持续对话界面结合，并以公开研究预览形式发布。

html.en: ChatGPT was trained with supervised dialogue examples and RLHF, with trainers playing both user and assistant roles during data collection. The conversational format lets prior turns become context, supporting follow-up questions, corrections and iterative tasks.
html.zh: ChatGPT 使用监督式对话样例和 RLHF 训练，数据收集时训练人员同时扮演用户与助手。对话格式把之前的轮次纳入上下文，从而支持追问、纠正和迭代任务。

html.en: Experts generally treat ChatGPT as the product event that made large language models a mainstream computing interface. Its legacy includes both the acceleration of conversational AI deployment and a much broader debate over hallucination, labor, education, copyright and governance.
html.zh: 专家通常把 ChatGPT 视为让大语言模型成为主流计算界面的产品事件。它的遗产既包括对话式 AI 部署加速，也包括围绕幻觉、劳动、教育、版权和治理展开的更广泛讨论。
